acceptance_criteria: The scene contains two readable local sections in one Godot scene.
The implementation preserves Phase 2 movement verbs: left, right, and fixed-height single ground jump only.
One hazard or moving obstacle is readable before punishment and can trigger a fail/retry state without adding health, lives, enemies, combat, or checkpoints.
One collectible/progression item is implemented as placeholder-only geometry and visibly changes UI/progression state.
The approved Phase 3E goal marker is reused as prototype-only goal visual without approving final art or production asset usage.
The approved Phase 3E obstacle/floor visuals may be reused only as prototype visual cues; collision remains simple and explicit.
Simple start/status/result/retry UI communicates state and does not become a full menu/settings/save system.
Camera framing or Camera2D follow keeps the player, hazard, collectible/progression feedback, and goal readable.
No new binary assets, Godot project config, scripts UID sidecars, schemas, profiles, owner reviews, QA reviews, Learning Cards, lifecycle moves, staging, committing, or pushing are introduced.
scripts/smoke_test.sh and headless scene runtime pass or blockers are recorded honestly in RUN-20260613-004.json.
The result is handed off to QA for independent review before Phase 4B implementation pass is claimed.
